name: AlgoSurg Inc
long_description: AlgoSurg builds surgical AI for medical device companies: anatomy AI and planning software that runs inside their robots, navigation systems and patient-specific devices. Our knee planning AI is licensed to leading implant OEMs and in commercial use on the robotic knee platform across India (200+ robots). Partners hold the clearances; we supply the software and its documentation. Hip, TAVR, bone tumor, shoulder, spine, CMF and IntraOp are in pilot/partner-testing/commercial/in-development.
one_liner: Surgical AI for medical device companies: Patient scan to robot-ready…
